articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: JPL reported on November 16, 2026 that Sentinel-6B completed initial checks and calibration as of October 30. The reference-role handoff is planned for January, inferred as January 2027 from that chronology; the later orbit adjustment and coverage gains remain prospective. Michael Freilich currently flies 30 seconds ahead: a flight-path timing separation, not an accuracy or warning-time figure. The indexed primary article and NASA measurement FAQ were inspected; direct JPL retrieval returned 403. No independent engineering-data reanalysis or measured downstream benefit is claimed.

articles.availability_note: JPL于2026年11月16日报道，哨兵六号B星截至10月30日已完成初期检查与校准。参考卫星交接计划在一月，依报道时间推定为2027年1月；后续轨道调整与覆盖收益仍属预期。迈克尔·弗赖利希星目前沿轨道领先30秒，指飞行时间间隔，并非精度或预警时间。本文查阅索引中的原始报道及NASA测量说明；JPL直接下载返回403。本文未独立重算工程数据，亦未将下游应用收益视为实测结果。

articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: NASA’s November 16, 2026 account distinguishes surviving stagnant ice from active flowing glaciers. Area fell from 4.31 km² in 1988 to 0.09 km² in September 2025; the October 19, 2026 image supplies no new total-area measurement. The 32 m, 4 m and November 2024 ice-loss sequence refers to one monitoring site. A December 2026 aerial survey is planned. Disappearance dates remain estimates. The primary article/captions and historical 2019 paper abstract, significance and study-site introduction were inspected; underlying measurements were not independently replicated.

articles.availability_note: NASA于2026年11月16日的报道区分现存停滞残冰与仍能流动的冰川。面积从1988年的4.31平方公里降至2025年9月的0.09平方公里；2026年10月19日影像并未提供新的总面积数值。32米、4米及2024年11月该处冰消失的记录仅限一个监测点。2026年12月航测仍属计划，消失年份仍是估计。本文查阅原始报道、图注及2019年论文的摘要、意义与研究地点介绍，未独立复现底层测量。
